description: What jabs do I need, can I take my medication, and what is the ambulance number? Returns the FCDO 'Health' section for one country as headed plain-text subsections: emergency medical number, vaccine and health-risk pointers, medicines rules and local healthcare. Live from the GOV.UK Content API. The FCDO points to TravelHealthPro and NHS fitfortravel for vaccine detail, which this tool does not fetch; it is not medical advice. (cost: 1 credit)

country.description: string, required, country name, alternative name (city, island) or GOV.UK slug, e.g. "ukraine"

name: travel_advice_health
